d: A lawyer becomes possessed by a powerful deity and battles injustice affecting marginalised communities. Meanwhile, the legal professional balances this divine calling with everyday challenges.
Brothers, Vibhooti and Chiraunji, run an exorcism business and take advantage of people's superstition. However, things take a horrifying turn when they accept a case from Maya.
Dharmadurai, a heartbroken doctor, turns to alcohol and becomes the source of embarrassment for his family. However, a meeting with an old friend changes his life for good.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.
Prithviraj Chauhan paints a target on his back when he agrees to offer Mir Hossain protection from his brother, Muhammad Ghori.
A young boy feels unnoticed and lonely without his parents' attention. Things take a turn for the better when the maid suggests that the family bring home an idol of Lord Ganesha.
After learning of a major terrorist operation from his traitorous former colleague, Anti-Terrorism Squad officer Ajay is tasked to lead a specialised team to dismantle the attack.
Babli is a street-smart woman, who leaves her small town for a well-paying job in the city but soon faces criticism that makes her regret her decision.
Seenu and Sunaina fall in love after he saves her from a violent policeman. However, their love story takes a turn when a gangster's daughter wants to marry Seenu.
A lawyer hoodwinks a woman to start his own law firm. However, he feels guilty and tries to make things right when he finds out that she commits suicide for failing to get justice for her husband.
